verdict.rationale: Workable advertises a 'Custom report builder' (pricing page) and offers a fairly rich documented REST API (jobs, candidates, events, requisitions, departments) plus webhooks for near-real-time data push, which analysts could use to build custom exports. However, there is no evidence of scheduled/automated exports, native BI connectors (Tableau, Looker, Power BI), or a dedicated reporting/analytics API distinct from the general recruiting API. missing for 10: scheduled export documentation, BI connector integrations, dedicated reporting-API/warehouse sync docs, independent corroboration of report builder capabilities.
